A solid weeknight dinner: **Sheet-pan chicken fajitas**. Slice 1 lb chicken breast, 1 bell pepper, 1 onion; toss with 2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp each cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, salt. Roast 425 °F / 220 °C for 18–20 min. Serve in warm tortillas with salsa, avocado, and a squeeze of lime. Ready in ~25 min, one pan to wash.
